help:
usage: wgsextract vcf [-h] <command> ...

positional arguments:
  <command>
    snp             Call Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms (SNPs) using bcftools. Best for standard
                    ancestry analysis and finding simple point mutations.
    indel           Call Small Insertions and Deletions (InDels) using bcftools. Used to find
                    small gaps or extra bases in the DNA sequence.
    call            Call several variant types in one run: SNPs and InDels (bcftools), SVs and
                    CNVs, each into its own VCF, and with --merge also into one combined VCF.
    annotate        Add external metadata (like population frequencies or disease risk) to your
                    VCF file.
    filter          Filter your results. Use this to focus on specific genes of interest or to
                    remove low-quality 'noisy' variant calls.
    table           Export variants and their annotations (gene, consequence, ClinVar, gnomAD,
                    genotype, depth, ...) as one row per variant, in a TSV (or Parquet) table and
                    an SQLite database to query.
    prepare         Repair a VCF from a sequencing service so other tools accept it: BGZF
                    compression, sorting, contig names and header lines, and a fresh index;
                    optionally split multiallelics and left-align indels. Reports every change.
    clinvar         Annotate VCF with ClinVar pathogenicity data.
    revel           Annotate VCF with REVEL pathogenicity scores.
    gnomad          Annotate VCF with gnomAD population frequencies.
    sv-freq         Annotate SVs with gnomAD-SV/gnomAD-LR frequencies.
    pharmgkb        Annotate VCF with PharmGKB drug metabolism data.
    info            Quick summary of a VCF, gVCF or BCF: reference build/model, samples, format,
                    and record counts.
    variantqc       Run DISCVRSeq VariantQC to generate an interactive HTML VCF quality report.
    granite-qc      Run granite qcVCF (dbmi-bgm/granite) for single-sample or family VCF quality
                    metrics.
    to-fasta        (advanced) Build your personal consensus genome: the reference FASTA with your
                    variants applied (heterozygous SNVs as IUPAC codes by default), and N where a
                    gVCF has no call.
    trio            (advanced) Analyze inheritance patterns. Compares a child's VCF with their
                    parents to identify de novo (new) mutations or inherited conditions.
    cnv             (advanced) Call Copy Number Variants (CNVs) using Delly. Detects large regions
                    of DNA that have been duplicated or deleted, affecting gene dosage. (Not
                    tested on macOS.)
    sv              (advanced) Call Structural Variants (SVs) using Delly for short reads,
                    Sniffles for Nanopore (ONT, auto-detected) or other long reads, or
                    pbsv/Sniffles for PacBio. Identifies large-scale DNA changes (over 50bp).
    freebayes       (advanced) A Bayesian genetic variant detector. Excellent for finding small
                    variants in complex regions or when you have variable sequencing depth.
    gatk            (advanced) Industry-standard GATK HaplotypeCaller. Best for high-accuracy
                    clinical-grade SNP and InDel calling using local de novo assembly.
    deepvariant     (advanced) Google's Deep Variant variant caller. Supports WGS/WES and PacBio
                    HiFi models; uses a neural network to achieve superior accuracy by 'looking'
                    at read alignments as images. (Not tested on macOS.)
    clair3          (advanced) Clair3 small-variant caller for Oxford Nanopore reads (optional;
                    Linux x86-64/ARM64 and Apple Silicon macOS, install with `pixi install -e
                    clair3`). DeepVariant remains the default ONT caller.
    phase           (advanced) Phase a sample's heterozygous calls with its reads (WhatsHap, or
                    LongPhase for Nanopore and PacBio), and optionally tag the reads by haplotype.
                    Optional; Linux and macOS, install with `pixi install -e phasing`.
    impute          (advanced) Impute a GRCh38 sample from the 1000 Genomes 30x panel: low-
                    coverage reads with GLIMPSE2, or a genotype-only VCF with Beagle. Optional;
                    Linux x64, Windows x64 and Intel macOS, `pixi install -e imputation`.
    phylop          (advanced) Annotate VCF with PhyloP conservation scores.
    cadd            (advanced) Annotate VCF with CADD deleteriousness scores (CADD_RAW,
                    CADD_PHRED).
    gerp            (advanced) Annotate VCF with GERP++ conservation scores (GERP).
    spliceai        (advanced) Annotate VCF with SpliceAI splicing scores.
    alphamissense   (advanced) Annotate VCF with AlphaMissense pathogenicity scores.
    acmg            (advanced) Research-only ACMG/AMP classes with fastVEP (opt-in).
    pharmcat        (advanced) Call star-allele diplotypes and drug-response phenotypes (CYP2C19,
                    CYP2C9, DPYD, ...) with PharmCAT, and write its prescribing report.
    chain-annotate  (advanced) Sequentially apply multiple annotations to a single VCF.

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit

global options:
  -i/--input, -o/--outdir, --genome, --ref, -t/--threads, -m/--memory, --json, --quiet, --debug,
  --config and the other global options are accepted before or after the command; 'wgsextract
  --help' lists them all.

actions.help: show this help message and exit
